fileStructure: Single self-contained index.html with Phaser 3 CDN in <head> and all game code inline in <body><script>. Five Phaser Scenes: BootScene, IntroScene, GameScene, PauseScene, GameOverScene.

modules.name: BootScene
modules.responsibility: Minimal boot scene. Generates procedural textures (player ship, obstacle, bonus orb, particle) using Graphics + generateTexture. Transitions to IntroScene.

modules.name: IntroScene
modules.responsibility: Renders title screen with animated title text, scrolling grid background, particle ambiance, control hints, and pulsing start prompt. Click/SPACE starts the game.

modules.name: GameScene
modules.responsibility: Core gameplay loop. Manages player movement (lane snapping with lerp), obstacle spawning (timed events with decreasing delay), collision detection, scoring, combo tracking, difficulty scaling. Renders HUD. Handles pause input.

modules.name: PauseScene
modules.responsibility: Overlay scene launched on top of GameScene. Dark semi-transparent backdrop, PAUSED text, resume prompt. ESC/click resumes.

modules.name: GameOverScene
modules.responsibility: Displays final score, high score comparison, stats. Dramatic entrance tweens. Play Again prompt triggers restart.

modules.name: SloppyGameAdapter
modules.responsibility: Top-level object assigned to window.SloppyGame and window.game. Implements all 12 SDK v2 methods by delegating to the appropriate Phaser scene. Manages game state machine.

criticalApis: Phaser.Physics.Arcade for collision (player vs obstacles overlap)
this.physics.add.group() for obstacle and bonus orb pooling
this.tweens.add() for smooth lane transitions, score animations, screen effects
this.cameras.main.shake() on near-miss, flash() on combo milestone
this.time.addEvent() for obstacle spawn timer with decreasing delay
this.add.particles() for player trail, explosion, and collection effects
performanceConstraints: Max 30 active obstacles on screen (recycle via disableBody when off-screen)
Particle emitter maxParticles capped at 50 per emitter
No per-frame allocations in update loop — pre-allocate vectors and reuse
Obstacle group maxSize: 40 with object pooling (getFirstDead pattern)

sdkV2Mapping.init: Create new Phaser.Game with AUTO renderer, parent=container, physics arcade. Register all 5 scenes. Listen for Phaser 'ready' event, then postMessage sloppy:game:ready. Set state to 'idle'.
sdkV2Mapping.start: scene.start('IntroScene'). Set state to 'intro'. IntroScene click handler calls scene.start('GameScene') and sets state to 'playing'.
sdkV2Mapping.pause: scene.launch('PauseScene') as overlay on top of GameScene. scene.pause('GameScene'). Set state to 'paused'.
sdkV2Mapping.restart: scene.stop all running scenes. scene.start('GameScene') fresh. Reset score, combo, speed. Set state to 'playing'.
sdkV2Mapping.destroy: phaserGame.destroy(true). Remove all event listeners. Null out references.
